correctness.rationale: Using the cited He column-count lemma, the ten low columns are 2,...,9,10,10 split across two strictly increasing side sequences; reflection reduces to the 163 subsets with size<=4. An independently implemented integer enumeration yields only empty,(4,7),(4,8). The (4,8) left sequence contradicts floor(3s2)-ceil(3s1)+1=10; (4,7) implies 0<s2<1/3, while its right r1=2 forces s3>=2 and r2=3 forces s3<2. The remaining empty shape is exactly the Gonzalez–Karu n=10 interpolation configuration; their published theorem then yields non-Mori-dreamness for 10s2 not integral. The independent rational mesh tested the combined left/right constraints and is not the unrestricted proof. No claim for d'>10 or 10s2 integral.
